pages.text: Biotech animal machines use captured mobs as items. Place a Net Trap on the ground and let a capturable mob step on it. The trap is consumed and the mob becomes an item that preserves safe gameplay state and can later be released.$(br)$(br)By default, cows, chickens, pigs, sheep, rabbits, horses, goats, llamas, and camels are capturable.

Cows, chickens, pigs, sheep, and rabbits keep their legacy Biotech item forms for recipe/world compatibility. Other supported mobs use the generic Captured Animal item, whose tooltip identifies the stored entity type.$(br)$(br)Pack makers can extend capture support with the $(code)biotech:capturable$() entity-type tag. A captured mob still needs a matching machine recipe before a Biotech machine can process it.
